title: No spacing-aware item removal in the edits algebra: deleting an item and collapsing blank lines is hand byte arithmetic
wanted_capability: A language-neutral edits primitive (for example edits.deleteItem({es, span, collapse})) or a separate leading/trailing trivia fact that removes an item together with its attached trivia and collapses the surrounding blank lines to the one-blank-line-between-items idiom, so cells never compute whitespace byte ranges by hand. Today edits.delete removes exact span bytes and code.items exposes only trivia_span, which merges leading and trailing trivia.
fallback_used: Used trivia_span (which merges leading+trailing trivia) plus code.read inspection and hand-computed zero-width spans.
resolution_note: Obsolete after PR #133 (https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/pull/133), merged and deployed at 237007630ef5700a610550e0d3dabc610ad6f550. The custom bro-harness, isolate, LSP/refactor runtime and their tool surfaces were removed. The affected custom-runtime capability is retired; this is not a claim that the requested feature was implemented in native providers.
